Superiority holds when the interval lies above zero, non-inferiority when its lower end lies above $-\delta=-0.01$, and ``no worse'' when the interval contains zero or lies above it. Nominal verdicts use unadjusted 95\% intervals; the fixed order was an order of reporting, not a gatekeeping sequence.
